note: e0 fixed at 0, LM only (no Nelder-Mead), dist rescaled to SNR 200 under 2nd-gen TDI. Converged run_1 sources: one full-T climb per model from the e0-free 2nd-gen fit with e0 dropped. Non-converged: 0PA T-ladder from the truth; PN = best of its own T-ladder from the truth and a full-T climb from the 0PA T=1 fit with C_p=0. sigma_lm_last_iter is fishinv of the last LM iteration's Fisher, not a Fisher at the final point.
